budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Each controlled pair captures the opposing flag while preserving its own flag at home, coordinating tags, rescue, handoff and finite recharge.
task.natural_termination: Either team reaches two captures. H=96 otherwise truncates; no scripted pursuer or automatic policy participates.
task.interaction: A tag temporarily removes an opponent movement/interaction opportunities and drops possession. An adjacent teammate can pay for early rescue, or receive a handed flag and finish the route. Team depot recharge is finite and contested by teammates.
task.observation_access: All dynamic strategic state is public and encoded: map, positions, teams, energy, frozen timers, flag possession, depot stock, scores and tag/rescue/pass/score events. All entity visibility masks are true; own identity/team labels distinguish the controlled perspective.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Player released by its teammate this tick
Player handed its flag to its teammate this tick
Player picked up enemy flag this tick
Player returned its own displaced flag this tick
Player drew a finite depot unit this tick
Player spent two energy to self-thaw this tick
Team scored a capture this tick

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
